risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or defective (e.g., dead unit, damaged internals).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual camera unit, showing the lens, solar panel, and any ports or indicators, along with a video clip demonstrating power-on, lens movement, and 4G connectivity.

risks.risk: The camera may not have 4G LTE functionality (e.g., SIM card slot missing or non-functional).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the SIM card slot and antenna port, and a video showing the camera connecting to a 4G network via a SIM card.

risks.risk: The solar panel may be non-functional or damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the solar panel surface and a video showing the camera operating under sunlight or charging indicator.

risks.risk: The camera may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit not matching the box claims.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera's serial number or model label, and a video showing the camera's interface or app connection.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the actual camera unit, showing all sides, lens, solar panel, and ports.
Send a video clip showing the camera powered on, lens panning/tilting, and connecting to 4G network.
Send a close-up photo of the SIM card slot and any model/serial number on the camera.
Send a photo of the camera in use, showing the live feed on a phone or app.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a POLY ISION T31 solar PTZ camera, and all seller claims are supported by the box. However, no actual camera unit is shown, and critical functional risks (4G, solar, working condition) cannot be verified remotely. Pricing requires proof of functionality and authenticity.
